canDoYue: 你識問租金同按金，仲識講如果今日決定就簽租約。
canDoEn: Ask about rent and the deposit, then say what happens if you decide today.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Good morning. I can show you this furnished flat today, and the lease covers the monthly water bill.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。我今日可以帶你睇呢間有傢俬嘅單位，租約包每月水費。
dialogue.say: Good morning. I can show you this furnished flat today, and the lease covers the monthly water bill.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: How much is the monthly rent please, and is the water included with the other utilities here?
dialogue.glossYue: 請問月租幾多，水費有冇連埋呢度其他公用開支？
dialogue.say: How much is the monthly rent please, and is the water included with the other utilities here?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: The monthly rent is due on the first day, and the deposit equals one full month here.
dialogue.glossYue: 月租每個月一號交，呢度按金等於一個完整月。
dialogue.say: The monthly rent is due on the first day, and the deposit equals one full month here.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The landlord allows a short viewing today, and the tenant can ask about the noisy street outside.
dialogue.glossYue: 業主今日可以畀人短睇樓，租客可以問外面條街嘈唔嘈。
dialogue.say: The landlord allows a short viewing today, and the tenant can ask about the noisy street outside.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: If I decide today, I can sign the lease, and the agency fee is on the contract.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我今日決定，我可以簽租約，代理費寫喺合約度。
dialogue.say: If I decide today, I can sign the lease, and the agency fee is on the contract.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: The flat is furnished already, and the utilities stay in the tenant name until the written notice ends.
dialogue.glossYue: 單位已經有傢俬，公用開支會用租客個名，直至書面通知完。
dialogue.say: The flat is furnished already, and the utilities stay in the tenant name until the written notice ends.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please read the contract with me, and tell me the notice period before I pay the deposit.
dialogue.glossYue: 請同我睇份合約，交按金之前話我知通知期幾長。
dialogue.say: Please read the contract with me, and tell me the notice period before I pay the deposit.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: If you sign the lease today, the landlord can give you the keys after the deposit clears.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果你今日簽租約，按金清咗業主可以交鎖匙。
dialogue.say: If you sign the lease today, the landlord can give you the keys after the deposit clears.
